_comment: Single source of truth for the on-device store. Edit ONLY this file, then run `npm run gen:cipher`. The TypeScript, Kotlin and Swift constants are generated from it and CI-checked for drift (`npm run check:cipher`).
createTableSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS probe_row (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ts_utc INTEGER NOT NULL, label TEXT NOT NULL)
selectSql: SELECT id, ts_utc, label FROM probe_row ORDER BY id
